tools.name: net_salary
tools.description: Take-home pay for an employee in India from a gross yearly salary in INR, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: New and old regime side by side, or the better of the two; 87A reb

tools.name: gross_for_target_net
tools.description: The gross yearly salary in India that leaves a given take-home pay, with the same situation options as net_salary. Use it to set a salary ask or check an offer.

tools.name: employer_cost
tools.description: What a salary in India costs the employer (employer social contributions itemised), or the reverse: the gross salary a total budget allows. Give gross_annual or budget_annual.

tools.name: compare_with_netherlands
tools.description: Take-home pay of a job in India (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

tools.name: tax_rules_covered
tools.description: The India rules the calculators apply (2026), the options they take, what is not modelled, and the official sources. Call it before answering a question the other tools may not cover.

tools.name: income_tax_return
tools.description: The complete India income tax computation for 2026-27, as on the return. Covers: New and old regime, always both, with the better one; Salary: HRA, LTA, perquisites, employer contributions above ₹7.5 lakh, professional tax; House property: self-occupied, let out, deemed let out, loss set-off and car

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "tax_rules_covered" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
